programs.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
programs.sub_title: A Renovation for Future Generations on Skiatook Lake
programs.desc: A married couple is on the hunt for a property on Oklahoma's Skiatook Lake, with plans to transform it into the ultimate lakeside retreat; a place to create lasting memories and eventually pass down to future generations of their family.

programs.title: Home Reimagined
programs.desc: A couple wants to update an old brick brewery into a forever home for their family; with Vern's help, they take a local landmark from cold and industrial to warm and stylish with an eclectic design.

programs.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
programs.sub_title: Hoping for Major Upgrades for Minimal Cost on Lake Erie
programs.desc: After selling their lake house in Indiana, a couple from Apollo, Pennsylvania searches for a weekend getaway closer to home; Lake Erie offers the perfect mix of convenience and charm with great food and wine.

programs.title: Magnolia Table: At the Farm
programs.desc: Joanna shares her three go-to cookie recipes, which are chocolate chip, frosted sugar cookie sandwich and the Silo cookie; she also reminisces about her childhood, sharing photos, as well as her personal favorite ways to enjoy each cookie.

programs.title: Ranch to Table
programs.desc: When Elizabeth Poett wants to cook with seafood, she heads to the Santa Barbara Harbor and picks up shrimp to serve with grilled steaks for a birthday dinner; for dessert, Elizabeth makes a peach buckle with caramel sauce.
